messages:
oliver_sales: Quick handoff to CS for MeadowLane (mid-market, analytics). They signed a Dedicated pilot (2x A100) with option for Private (VPC + on-prem connector). Executive sponsor: Naomi Park (Head of Data). Go-live pilot target 2024-08-05. Known risks: KMS integration for PCI scope, SAML cert rotation, and prompt precision on tokenized invoices. Uploading prompt pack and procurement contact. tagging @maddie_cs and @zach_eng. :handshake:

maddie_cs: Thanks Oliver, I can take CSM ownership. I'll run the kickoff and own enablement. Need procurement contact + exact PCI/KMS requirements from Legal. Also want baseline success metrics (latency target, extraction accuracy) to set renewal watch thresholds.

frank_csm: Day-to-day CSM here. Planning kickoff week of 7/29. Please confirm whether they want nightly evals vs weekly, and who will provide labeled GT. Also ask Eng/SE to join a 20m slot for SSO + prompt tuning.

oliver_sales: Procurement = vendorops@meadowlane.com, Legal note: asked for HSM/KMS attestations and PCI scoping addendum. Prompt pack link in shared drive. They asked for cost per 1k tokens and an initial forecast.

ticket_bot: Created tickets CS-9155 "MeadowLane network/KMS details needed" and ENG-7344 "MeadowLane SAML + KMS integration - triage" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9155 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7344

zach_eng: I'll triage ENG-7344. ETA 72h for first pass. Need SAML metadata XML, allowed CIDR ranges, KMS vendor + key rotation windows, and whether customer requires HSM-backed keys. Can join kickoff for infra portion. Recommend enabling prefix caching for repeated system prompts and a guardrail policy for expensive context windows.

lina_se: I'll own runbook + cost model. Draft checklist items: 1) VPC peering CIDR & firewall rules; 2) SAML metadata + test SP user; 3) KMS/HSM integration notes and audit log export; 4) model pin + quant profile; 5) nightly eval harness & alert thresholds. Quick provisioning snippet for ops:

```
# MeadowLane provisioning vars
CUSTOMER=meadowlane
POOL_MIN=2
MODEL=redwood-v2-13b-quant
PIN=true
VPC_PEER=true
USE_KMS=true
```

frank_csm: Enablement ask 1) Eng/SE to join a 20m slot during kickoff to walk SSO/KMS test flow, prompt engineering tips, and cost per 1k tokens; 2) CSM to collect 50 labeled GT examples (customer supplies 20, product adds 30); 3) Run nightly evals during pilot and alert if extraction accuracy < 94%. @zach_eng @lina_se

zach_eng: We can run nightly evals once GT is available. For KMS/HSM: if they require HSM, we'll need security sign-off and timeline for key import. Also recommend fallback policy to redwood-v1-7b during pool saturation.

maddie_cs: Action items (initial): 1) Oliver to confirm procurement/legal KMS requirements and upload final prompt pack (PRIORITY) 2) Ticket_bot tickets CS-9155 / ENG-7344 active 3) Zach to triage SAML/KMS (ETA 72h) 4) Lina to share runbook + cost forecast by EOD tomorrow 5) Frank to schedule kickoff week of 7/29 and collect GT examples. I'll track weekly progress and raise renewal-risk if pilot metrics < targets. Anything to add or reassign? :eyes:
